grid.basis: The complete preregistered 6 by 5 by 5 designed grid. Values are structural stresses, not 150 historical events.

layered_policy_coverage.design_name: compact axial-and-corner reclosure sensitivity with full physical certificate
layered_policy_coverage.policy_cell_rule: Six open-axis cells at intensity 0.85 and duration 8, five intensity-axis cells at open 4 and duration 8, five duration-axis cells at open 4 and intensity 0.85, with the common reference counted once, plus the two preregistered joint corners: 16 unique cells.
layered_policy_coverage.full_five_policy_anchor_rule: The reference, mild-corner and severe-corner cells add Projected stochastic MPC and Model-guided constrained SAC. The anchors were fixed before results and are not selected from policy outcomes.
layered_policy_coverage.inference_boundary: Three-policy confidence sets are valid across the 16 policy cells; five-policy confidence sets are valid only at the three anchors. No complete 150-cell policy leader surface is claimed.

event_aligned_constructor.recovery_basis: The common eight-week linear recovery horizon equals the accepted MPC and readiness lead horizon; it is generated by one constructor for all cells.
event_aligned_constructor.normal_demand_extension: Repeat the accepted path-specific 21-week pre-event-residual normal-activity block cyclically; the same continuation is used by all grid cells and policies for a physical path.
event_aligned_constructor.released_information_extension: Carry forward the last legally released 5.2.1 HMM belief and lead-aligned forecast after the 21-week historical window; no future GPR value or scenario label is introduced.

policy_rule: Passive and Reactive continue to use the current production state. Projected stochastic MPC is evaluated at the three frozen anchors. BC and MG constrained SAC use the three frozen accepted 5.2.2 checkpoints; BC is evaluated in all 16 policy cells and MG at the anchors. No grid-cell retraining is allowed.

path_design.target_basis: Inherited 5.2.2 preregistered target: 5 percent of the 45112.7565 reference failure loss
path_design.required_count_formula: ceil((t_(0.975,N-1)*paired_sd/target_halfwidth)^2), bounded below by 88 and capped for execution at 196
path_design.learning_seed_rule: Average the three frozen learning seeds within each physical path before any inference.

absorption_certificate.implementation: tre84.diagnostics.AbsorptionBoundaryLP with route-specific lag convolution and gateway-specific optimistic shared-corridor allocation
absorption_certificate.initial_state_basis: Zero legacy workload is an additional optimistic relaxation; violation remains sufficient, while nonviolation proves neither feasibility nor policy existence.
absorption_certificate.capacity_envelope: base capacity plus the componentwise maximum direct and exercised-readiness increments; feedback is fixed at its most favorable multiplier one and budget coupling is relaxed
absorption_certificate.shared_corridor_rule: Each gateway-specific program receives the complete reachable shared-corridor envelope; gateway certificates are never summed.
absorption_certificate.cell_hatching_rule: Hatch only cells for which every one of the executed matched physical paths violates at least one gateway certificate.

inference.multiplicity: Holm-adjusted paired p-values and Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals within each preregistered cell-reference family
inference.regret_definition: Path-paired policy loss minus the minimum loss among the policies preregistered for that cell: three policies over all 16 cells and five policies at the three anchors
inference.confidence_set_rule: Retain a policy unless its simultaneous lower confidence bound above the sample leader is strictly positive within the cell's preregistered policy family

historical_marker.basis: 5.1: 23 days from the 18 June opening to 11 July renewed closure; week-of-13-July serviceability 0.1626343882333013. Duration remains unobserved.

execution.gate_contract: The one-path gate must pass every policy-cell trajectory contract. The eight-path gate estimates runtime and numerical failure rate only. Neither gate is formal statistical evidence.
execution.weekly_output: gzip-partitioned CSV dataset to avoid an unsafe multi-gigabyte in-memory concatenation
